items.title: Europe's Multilingual Reality Exposes AI Security Gaps
items.description: The AI security layer and guardrails for many AI products don't evenly protect against jailbreaking and unsafe actions in every single language.

items.title: Fake Notepad++ Plugin Delivers MATCHBOIL.V2 in UAC-0099 Attacks

items.title: Data Breach Confirmed After Australian Energy Giant Origin Is Hacked
items.description: A hacker claims to have stolen the information of 2 million Origin Energy customers and is threatening to leak it. The post Data Breach Confirmed After Australian Energy Giant Origin Is Hacked appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Services Outage Impacted Teams, Copilot, Purview and Other Services
items.description: A Microsoft 365 outage disrupted access to several widely used enterprise services, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Copilot Chat, Microsoft Purview, and Power BI. The incident primarily affected customers whose Microsoft 365 traffic was routed through the North America region. items.title: Hackers Allegedly Claim Breach of Decathlon Customer Database With 160 Million Records
items.description: A threat actor is allegedly claiming to possess and sell a Decathlon customer database containing approximately 160 million records. The database was advertised on a cybercrime forum, where the seller stated that payment would be accepted through cryptocurrency.
